description: Komandamız iki ildən artıqdır startap və innovasiya sahəsində fəaliyyət göstərir. Müxtəlif yarış və hackathonlarda iştirak etmiş, uğurlar qazanmış, dövlət qrantları və dəstəyi əldə etmişik. Toplam olaraq 13.000 manatdan çox investisiya əldə etmişik müxtəlif yarışlardan. Kənd təsərrüfatı, texnologiya və süni intellekt istiqamətlərində layihələr hazırlayırıq. Öyrənməyə və əməkdaşlığa açıq komandamız ideyaları real həllərə çevirməyə fokuslanır.
summary: AgroOrbit is an intelligent digital agriculture platform designed to transform how agricultural land is monitored, analyzed and managed worldwide. Its mission is to make advanced agricultural technologies accessible to farmers and agricultural businesses, enabling smarter, more accurate and data-driven decisions.The platform integrates satellite imagery, multispectral drone data, weather information and field-specific data into one unified environment. By combining artificial intelligence, geospatial analysis and vegetation indices, AgroOrbit aims to identify crop development variations, potential stress zones and areas requiring attention.AgroOrbit transforms complex agricultural data into practical insights and recommendations, supporting farmers in making better decisions regarding irrigation, fertilization, crop monitoring and resource management. This approach can help reduce unnecessary costs, optimize resource consumption and minimize the risk of productivity losses.Designed with global scalability in mind, AgroOrbit aims to connect satellite technology, drone capabilities and artificial intelligence in a single digital ecosystem, contributing to more efficient, sustainable and data-driven agriculture across the world.
details: AgroOrbit is an innovative digital agriculture platform that combines satellite imagery, multispectral drone data, weather information and artificial intelligence to improve agricultural monitoring and decision-making.The platform analyzes data from multiple sources to monitor crop conditions, identify vegetation differences and detect potential stress areas using vegetation indices such as NDVI and NDRE. AI-powered analysis aims to transform complex agricultural data into practical insights and recommendations for farmers.AgroOrbit supports more informed decisions in irrigation, fertilization and crop management, helping optimize resource consumption, reduce operational costs and minimize potential productivity losses.By integrating satellite technology, drone capabilities, geospatial analysis and AI, AgroOrbit aims to create a scalable digital ecosystem that makes precision agriculture more accessible and efficient worldwide.
